label: ModSecurity CRS managed-policy connector
summary: Prepare reviewed OWASP CRS policy provenance, staged changes and defensive findings for an admitted ModSecurity integration.
core_boundary: The native WAF/web-server integration and essential security controls remain Core-owned and free. The plugin does not load arbitrary native modules, rules, code or host configuration. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify an admitted Core engine/binding and CRS policy profile with immutable rule provenance, compatibility evidence and explicit site ownership.
Exercise detection-first rollout, body/resource limits, application false positives, exceptions, rollback and protected-route behavior before approving blocking changes.
Treat findings and remote rules as untrusted; never perform active attacks on customer sites or claim L7 rules prevent an upstream network-capacity DDoS.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
